title: Closer de Vendas
description:
CONDIÇÕES DA VAGA:


100% Home Office.

Pessoa Jurídica (MEI).

Dedicação exclusiva em 8 horas diárias de trabalho.

Remuneração fixa iniciando em R$1.500,00 podendo ir até R$2.000,00 + variável em % sobre as vendas.


Formulário de Aplicação:


DESCRIÇÃO DA OPORTUNIDADE


Nossa agência está buscando um prestador(a) de serviços Closer de Vendas, para integrar nossa equipe e atuar como ponto focal entre a agência e nossos clientes. Buscamos um profissional com excelente habilidade de comunicação, capacidade de resolver problemas e comprometimento em oferecer a melhor experiência para os clientes.


DAS RESPONSABILIDADES


Responsável por confirmar reunião com potencial cliente alguns minutos antes

Responsável por follow-up com potenciais clientes pós reunião

Responsável por realizar as call de vendas para vender o serviço da empresa (Gestão de Tráfego) 

Responsável por conduzir o lead ao fechamento do serviço 

Responsável por redigir o contrato, enviar ao cliente e colher assinatura 


DOS REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


Experiência ou curso/formação na área de Vendas.

Cursos de atendimento ao cliente ou curso superior na área de Marketing ou administração será considerado um diferencial.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em português.

Habilidade para resolver problemas e lidar com situações adversas.

Domínio de ferramentas de CRM, gestão de projetos e pacote Office.

Comprometimento com a excelência no atendimento e satisfação do cliente.

Espírito de equipe e habilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo.

title: Analista Pleno/a de Tesouraria
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Analista Pleno/a de Tesouraria, com atuação em nossa sede, localizada na Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP . Este/a profissional terá estas atribuições principais:


  • Realizar a gestão das operações de mútuos entre empresas do Grupo, contando com a contabilização dos juros no sistema, bem como a atualização de contratos e aditivos e consolidação em relatório;
  • Acompanhar operações de Debêntures, realizar a validação de documentações e cálculos, bem como elaborar relatórios à gerência e consultorias junto a órgãos públicos;
  • Assegurar o correto funcionamento dos controles internos de contas a pagar e tesouraria, visando o cumprimento das diretrizes financeiras corporativas;
  • Contribuir para gestão de caixa, qualificando e otimizando a programação financeira do(s) projetos(s);
  • Atuar de forma proativa na redução de custos e gestão eficiente do caixa;
  • Minimizar impactos cambiais ou de taxa de juros nas operações, seja por instrumentos de proteção ou operações financeiras;
  • Assegurar e ampliar o bom relacionamento junto as instituições financeiras, conhecendo suas particularidades, limitações e operacionalidade.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Possuir Formação Superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia e/ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência profissional pregressa com o sistema XRT será um diferencial;
  • Desejável possuir conhecimentos em Matemática Financeira, bem como noções em operações do Mercado Financeiro como Dívidas e Empréstimos;
  • Necessário possuir conhecimentos intermediários em língua inglesa;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Engenheiro de infraestrutura
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global. Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Perfil: Engenheiro de Infra / Virtualização

Contratação: CLT

Modalidade: Remoto

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no provisionamento, migração, sustentação e configuração dos novos ambientes de virtualização.
  • Executar testes, análises de performance e tuning dos novos hipervisores.
  • Apoiar arquitetos e Tech Lead na implementação técnica da solução.
  • Monitorar ambientes, documentar evidências e reportar andamento das entregas.
  • Utilizar Jira e Confluence para organização e registro das atividades.

Requisitos

  • Vivência sólida em VMware e XenServer.
  • Experiência com plataformas Huawei DCS.
  • Conhecimento de Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Capacidade de troubleshooting em ambiente virtualizado e infra.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em migração entre plataformas de virtualização.
  • Certificações relacionadas a virtualização, infraestrutura ou cloud.

O que oferecemos:

VA ou VR | VT | Seguro de Vida | Assistência Médica | Plano Odontológico | Benefício Academia | Mentoria | Desconto em universidades e instituições de idiomas | Universidade corporativa | Atendimento psicológico | Clubes de desconto | E muito mais!

title: Staff Software Engineer – .Net / AWS
description:
Staff Software Engineer – .Net / AWS

Location: Fully remote (based in Brazil)

Work Flexibility: Opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for certain periods

Salary: $7,000-$9,000 per month


Role Overview

We are looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who brings advanced technical acumen and an ability to take broad ownership. This is a predominantly development-focused role (approx. 90 % coding, 10 % DevOps) suited to someone who wants to be accountable for both crafting software and maintaining its operational integrity.

In this position you will help drive the evolution of a large-scale identity and access management platform, modernize legacy components, solve deep technical challenges, and provide mentorship to other engineers. If you relish complex systems and enjoy making code resilient, maintainable and efficient, this is the role for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate and resolve non-trivial system problems that traverse multiple services, systems or environments.
  • Quickly acquaint yourself with unfamiliar large codebases, often with little prior documentation.
  • Guide and coach other engineers in software architecture, debugging methodologies and technical design.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and QA functions to trace issues across deployment pipelines, APIs and operational environments.
  • Refactor and enhance existing modules to increase performance, reliability and maintainability.
  • Create and maintain documentation of key technical findings, and build diagnostic and troubleshooting frameworks that can be reused.


Required Skills & Background

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in professional software engineering, delivering production-grade systems.
  • Expert proficiency in C# and .NET (Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10+) , with an emphasis on clean, secure, scalable code.
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational database systems (e.g., MSSQL, MySQL), along with exposure to ElasticSearch and Redis .
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build and optimise distributed, high-volume data flows and integration patterns.
  • Solid familiarity with IIS , Docker , Kubernetes (EKS) , and containerization on both Windows and Linux platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (including but not limited to EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Practical experience working with CI/CD and automation tools such as GitHub Actions , TeamCity , Terraform .
  • Awareness of monitoring and security tools such as Prometheus , Grafana , GuardDuty , AWS Inspector , New Relic .
  • Strong experience aross leadership, mentoring & documentation.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-moving, cross-functional engineering environment.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote working arrangement from Brazil.
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world for certain periods each year.
  • Flexible working hours aligned to outcomes rather than fixed location or schedule.
  • Supportive engineering culture.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager


**Add resumes in English**


In this role, you will collaborate with key infrastructure stakeholders and business partners in defining project scope, interpreting requirements and priorities, and leading the modernization and transformation of systems. The projects you lead will primarily include infrastructure and application integrations and other infrastructure initiatives. Ideally you are highly skilled in communicating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and C-Suite Executives and you have a well-rounded understanding of the various components of an enterprise IT environment.


Responsabilities:

• Drive project management decisions, governance, and long-term vision.

• Analyze divisional business requirements and translate these into technical deliverables organized as Executive Milestones (In/Out of Scope).

• Develop expert 'As Is' knowledge of platform systems and help define 'To Be' system solutions and flows (e.g., must understand before planning).

• Understand infrastructure requirements and deployment of solutions for OnPrem and Cloud Computing service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).

• Analyze data to identify key insights and apply them to the business; quantitative and qualitative analysis.

• Ensure coordination of teams to drive timely completion of deliverables of large projects.

• Manage project budgets and financials, including resource allocations supporting a project’s schedule.

• Define and provide KPI’s and metrics for assigned projects.

• Interact closely with stakeholders and vendors and provide communications to executive management.

• Operationally troubleshoot or lead the troubleshooting of complex issues.

• Proactively ensure compliance (processes, standards, methodology) with expected quality.

• Responsible for project-related organizational change management including communications, training, and adoption.

• General understanding of infrastructure requirements to deploy solutions for storage, middleware, DB, voice specifics (call/contact centers), and network (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancing, WAF).

• Definition, implementation, and adoption of processes.


Requirements:

• Advanced English (mandatory)

• Bachelor’s degree and solid experience in Project/Program Management.

• Experience managing merger and acquisition infrastructure and application integration or divestiture projects preferred.

• Project Management Professional and/or Certified Scrum Master preferred.

• Experience managing requirements for multiple large, complex, and cross functional projects. Emphasis on systems, technologies, business process redesign, and knowledge of technical environments.

• Experience producing detailed project plans and resource requirements.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills – must be comfortable speaking and writing interacting with C-level audiences, as well as technical and non-technical audiences.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and negotiation skills.

• Proven ability to write business requirements, including user stories, use case development and work-flow documentation.

• Product and project management skills; business judgment, including ability to balance resources, evaluate and address risks, and concisely articulate where trade-off decisions are to be made.

• Strong orientation to user-base, including ability to understand needs and apply this knowledge to product enhancements, online user experience, and communication content (internal and external).

  • Assegurar que a comunicação esteja alinhada às normas regulatórias e às boas práticas clínicas (GCP)
  • Identificar e propor soluções estratégicas, promovendo a eficiência operacional em todas as fases dos projetos, atuando de forma preventiva, se antecipando na identificação de riscos


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar todas as etapas dos estudos clínicos e atividades de monitoria, sob sua gestão
  • Estruturar cronogramas das atividades de estudos clínicos e garantir plena adesão aos cronogramas
  • Manter comunicação eficaz e assertiva com equipe do estudo, antecipando problemas e discutindo melhores estratégias e prioridades
  • Avaliar riscos e implementar medidas corretivas quando necessário, para manter o andamento do estudo
  • Apoiar as Gerentes de: Projetos e Operações Clínicas na gestão de recursos, para garantir a execução do estudo conforme o planejado.
  • Atuar como mentor dos CRA’s
  • Revisar os relatórios de visitas de monitoramento dos CRA’s e métricas de visitas de monitoramento, incluindo desvios de protocolo e itens de acompanhamento, para avaliar conformidade e tendências
  • Gerenciar o progresso dos estudos atribuídos rastreando submissões e aprovações regulatórias, recrutamento e elegibilidade, preenchimento da CRF e geração e resolução de queries.
  • Desenvolver materiais como plano de monitoria, apresentação de SIV, Newsletter e ferramentas para auxílio no processo de suas atividades, auxílio em processo contratual, apresentações em meeting de investigadores
  • Participar na preparação e na execução de auditorias e nas atividades de acompanhamento, conforme necessário


REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

- Formação Acadêmica:

  • Curso superior completo na área da Saúde: Farmácia, Biomedicina, Fisioterapia, entre outros
  • Formação em Pesquisa Clínica será considerado diferencial
  • Especialização /pós-graduação em gestão de projetos ou semelhante será um diferencial


- Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento das Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e diretrizes regulatórias aplicáveis em Pesquisa Clínica
  • Conhecimentos de processo regulatório de estudos, incluindo documentos essenciais e ANVISA
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas ou apps de gestão de projetos, gestão de tarefas


- Experiência:

  • Experiência em pesquisa clínica de no mínimo 6 anos, especialmente em gerenciamento de Centros e Monitoria


- Idiomas

  • Inglês – Obrigatório - Avançado
  • Espanhol - Obrigatório - Avançado

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos

Conhecimento Técnico

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de fluxos de dados (Ex: Nifi, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue ETL)

• Conhecimento em Python e SQL

• Conhecimento em modelagem de dados

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de transformação de dados (Ex: dbt, EMR, Databricks)

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex: Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Degster)

• Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL).

• Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se efetivamente em inglês.

• Capacidade de aprender e seguir padrões de trabalho (Agile)

• Capacidade de identificar problemas e sugerir soluções.


Responsabilidade

• Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados para a ingestão, limpeza e transformação de dados.

• Coletar, limpar e transformar dados brutos em formatos utilizáveis para análise.

• Modelar e utilizar bancos de dados relacionais (SQL), e data warehouses.

• Colaborar com analistas de dados para fornecer datasets refinados.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Cientista de Dados
description:
Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Fundamentos Estatísticos:

o Testes de hipótese

o Validação de modelos preditivos

o Métricas de avaliação e explicabilidade de modelos (SHAP, LIME, etc.)

  • Machine Learning & Deep Learning:

o Domínio dos principais algoritmos supervisionados e não supervisionados

o Experiência prática na construção, avaliação e ajuste de modelos

  • Desenvolvimento com Python:

o Conhecimento das principais PEPs (Python Enhancement Proposals)

o Experiência com bibliotecas como scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch

o Desenvolvimento e disponibilização de modelos via APIs (FastAPI, Flask, etc.)

  • Integração com LLMs (Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala):

o Experiência em engenharia de prompts

o Desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes integrados a LLMs (ex: GPT)

  • Plataformas e Ferramentas:

o Experiência com Databricks

o Conhecimento em SQL para manipulação de dados

o Uso de GIT para versionamento de código


Experiência Desejada:

  • Participação em projetos de:

o Construção e publicação de modelos de machine learning

o Disponibilização de modelos como serviços via APIs

o Desenvolvimento de Agentes de IA (Intelligent Agents)


Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação remota
  • Contratação CLT

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Project Manager
description:
Position Overview


English fluency is mandatory. Reading & Writing


The Project Manager will handle day-to-day client project oversight, material sourcing, scheduling, and progress updates. This role requires someone who thrives in operational work, communicates clearly, and keeps projects moving efficiently. English fluency is mandatory.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage client projects end-to-end, from kickoff through final delivery.
  • Communicate with clients regularly in both Portuguese and English , providing clear updates and gathering requirements.
  • Build and manage detailed project and production schedules, ensuring tasks, timelines, and dependencies stay on track.
  • Ordering and source all required materials and resources for each project.
  • Track shipments, delivery timelines, and availability of required materials.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure expectations and responsibilities are clearly aligned.
  • Proactively identify risks and adjust schedules or resources to avoid delays.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, project notes, and status updates inside Worktables systems.
  • Ensure clients always have clear visibility into progress, upcoming steps, and any changes.
Qualifications
  • 3-5 years Experience minimum is required
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) — required.
  • Proven experience managing projects , including timelines, deliverables, and client communication.
  • Experience managing orders, procurement, and project scheduling — required.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple active projects.
  • Excellent communication and coordination abilities.
  • Experience working with project management systems (monday.com is a plus).
  • Ability to work onsite full-time in our Curitiba office.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven mindset.



To apply - please submit your details to this link below

title: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant to join our Global D365 Blueprint Maintenance Team. This role focuses on supporting L3 and L4 bug fixes and managing change requests related to localization and legal requirements in the LATAM market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional expertise in Dynamics 365 Finance modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Cash & Bank, Tax.
  • Ensure compliance with Finance Localizations for South America, primarily Brazil and Argentina.
  • Collaborate with global teams to maintain and enhance the D365 blueprint.
  • Address change requests arising from localization or legal changes.


Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of D365 Finance modules and ERP lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of financial principles and accounting standards.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps. Familiarity with Power Platform is a plus.
  • Proficiency in documentation and stakeholder communication.
  • Advanced English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.
  • Flexibility to work slightly earlier hours for overlap with CET (8 AM – 5 PM).


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect



Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant to join our Global D365 Blueprint Maintenance Team. This role focuses on supporting L3 and L4 bug fixes and managing change requests related to localization and legal requirements in the LATAM market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional expertise in Dynamics 365 Finance modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Cash & Bank, Tax.
  • Ensure compliance with Finance Localizations for South America, primarily Brazil and Argentina.
  • Collaborate with global teams to maintain and enhance the D365 blueprint.
  • Address change requests arising from localization or legal changes.


Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of D365 Finance modules and ERP lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of financial principles and accounting standards.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps. Familiarity with Power Platform is a plus.
  • Proficiency in documentation and stakeholder communication.
  • Advanced English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.
  • Flexibility to work slightly earlier hours for overlap with CET (8 AM – 5 PM).


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect

title: Tech Lead (Java)
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!


#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

Como Tech Lead, você irá desenvolver soluções tecnológicas, utilizando as mais atuais tecnologias do mercado, em Java. No seu dia a dia, além do desenvolvimento da plataforma, você irá realizar peer code reviews, contribuindo para a qualidade do código que entregamos.

Para a nossa vaga de Tech Lead, buscamos pessoas que tenham sede de mudança, dispostas a se tornarem verdadeiros agentes de transformação.


Buscamos por alguém com:

  • Experiência comprovada na coordenação técnica de equipes, orientando os membros no desenvolvimento de projetos.
  • Habilidade para manter um relacionamento positivo com a área de produto, atuando como ponte entre o Product Owner (PO) e o time técnico.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar a equipe de forma alinhada às expectativas e prioridades da área de produto.
  • Participação ativa em refinamentos junto ao PO e proposição de soluções técnicas inovadoras.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações backend e integrações de sistemas
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de sistemas legados
  • Participar da análise técnica de soluções e estimativas
  • Garantir qualidade e boas práticas de codificação
  • Apoiar na construção de testes e integração contínua


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Java 7/8
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL
  • Experiência com ferramentas de integração contínua como Jenkins
  • Controle de versionamento com GitLab
  • Integrações e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP
  • Desenvolvimento com JEE (Java Enterprise Edition)
  • Experiência com Angular e JavaScript para interfaces web
  • Conhecimento em JPA (Java Persistence API)
  • CDI (Contexts and Dependency Injection)
  • Relatórios com Jaspersoft
  • Build de projetos com Maven
  • Desejável experiência em APIC/Barramento


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.

title: Desenvolvedor .NET - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend .NET - Sênior para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Levantar requisitos, desenvolver e corrigir problemas em aplicações;
  • Promover a automatização e otimização de processos e análises;
  • Relacionamento próximo com as áreas de negócio e outras equipes de IT;
  • Garantir a alta disponibilidade das plataformas criando e evoluindo processos de deploy (blue/green e canary deployment);
  • Desenvolvimento de software seguindo metodologias ágeis e utilizando as melhores práticas de orientação a objetos e de clean code.


Requisitos e qualificações

Hard Skills:


  • Experiencia como líder técnico
  • Perfil Hands on
  • Experiencia com nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc)
  • Experiência com .NET (C#)

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior | Node.js/TypeScript e AWS Serverless
description:
Na GrooveTech somos referência em inovação e excelência técnica no universo da tecnologia da informação. Atuamos com serviços de ITO (Information Technology Outsourcing), NOC 24x7 e Projetos Consultivos, sendo parceiros estratégicos de grandes empresas no Brasil.

Combinamos inteligência, tecnologia e foco em entregar soluções completas, eficientes e que geram impacto real nos negócios. Somos o seu time de tecnologia!


A pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior será fundamental na construção e manutenção da nossa arquitetura de microsserviços em nuvem. Buscamos um profissional com forte domínio em TypeScript/Node.js, que irá atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance, com foco na lógica de aplicação e na integração de serviços.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento Core: Desenvolver e manter APIs REST utilizando NestJS, TypeScript e Go, em uma arquitetura serverless.

Persistência de Dados: Trabalhar com o banco de dados DynamoDB para persistência e modelagem de dados.

Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Construir e manter a infraestrutura AWS serverless utilizando Terraform (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, entre outros).

Arquitetura: Desenvolver soluções seguindo padrões de Clean Architecture e princípios de alta qualidade de código.

Sistemas de Eventos: Criar e integrar serviços baseados em eventos.

Testes: Implementar testes unitários e de integração utilizando Jest.

DevOps: Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Serverless Framework, GitHub e CodePipeline.

Monitoramento: Monitorar o desempenho e a saúde das aplicações utilizando DataDog e CloudWatch.

Colaboração: Participar ativamente de revisões de código e discussões técnicas de arquitetura.


Buscamos um profissional que possua:

Experiência Sênior: Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor Backend.

Tecnologia e Domínio: Forte domínio em TypeScript e Node.js.

AWS Serverless: Conhecimento avançado em AWS Serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, SQS/SNS, entre outros).

IaC: Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform.

Bancos NoSQL: Conhecimento em bancos de dados NoSQL, especialmente DynamoDB.

Frameworks Serverless: Vivência com Serverless Framework.

Arquitetura: Familiaridade com padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design - DDD).

Segurança/Autenticação: Conhecimento em OAuth2/JWT e sistemas de autenticação.

Testes: Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando Jest.

Containerização: Conhecimento em Docker e containerização.

Documentação: Familiaridade com Swagger/OpenAPI para documentação de APIs.

Inglês Avançado: Para comunicação com cliente internacional.


Diferenciais

Experiência com Kafka ou outras plataformas de streaming.

Conhecimento e experiência prática em Go (Golang).

Familiaridade com Dynamoose ODM para interação com DynamoDB.

Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade via DataDog.

Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

Vivência no segmento de fintech.

Conhecimento em PCI Compliance.


Informações Adicionais:

Contratação PJ

Remoto

Seguro de Vida.

Bem-Estar: Wellhub (antigo Gympass).

Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Programas de Mentoria e Desenvolvimento com nossos especialistas.

Progressão de Carreira.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
segue certinha a vaga:


Procuramos um profissional para ajudar a evolução do nosso ecossistema de dados baseado DeltaLake/Spark/Superset, governança, qualidade e performance. Papel hands-on, autonomia e impacto direto no negócio.


Responsabilidades:


- Desenvolver e operar pipelines escaláveis baseados em Python.


- Modelar dados, usando um arquitetura medalhão, otimizando custo e performance.


- Otimizar consultas, partições, índices e storage (Parquet/Delta).


- Monitorar saúde/custos dos pipelines e documentar arquitetura, fluxos e dicionário de dados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:


- SQL avançado e modelagem.


- Python, Spark, Deltalake e Arquitetura Medalhão.


- Desenvolvimento de pipelines em python e Airflow;


- Versionamento com GitHub e CI/CD.


- Métodos ágeis e comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio.


Diferenciais:


- Conhecimentos de Superset (implantação/uso).


- Conhecimento de Lakehouse.


- Boas práticas de Data Viz.


- Inglês técnico.


Importante é menos foco microsoft e mais foco opensource, python, spark, airdlow, etc

title: Application Specialist
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based platform within the Salesforce ecosystem for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation.


We are looking to hire an Application Specialist to join our Solutions team. This role will focus on building logical workflows, helping customize the platform to client needs, and collaborating with global teams to design and implement tailored technical solutions.


This role is perfect for someone analytical, communicative, and globally curious - someone who enjoys digging into the “why” not just the “how”, and who is both business and tech/logic oriented.


The ideal candidate has studied informations systems or industrial engineering and has recently graduated.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement logic-driven processes to fit unique client workflows
  • Provide technical support and guide clients through the onboarding process
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into actionable solutions
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams
  • Investigate edge cases and troubleshoot issues
  • Advise clients on ways to improve performance and optimize their projects


Requirements:

  • Recent graduate (up to 1 year post-graduation) with a degree in Industrial Engineering (Information Systems focus) or Information Systems .
  • Strong academic performance in Algorithms, Databases, and Programming
  • Excellent analytical skills and structured logical thinking
  • Fluent in English
  • Background in technical support, software implementation, or system configuration is a plus
  • Familiarity with APIs, data structures, and system integration tools is an advantage


Why Join TITAN?:

  • Work with globally distributed, multicultural teams
  • Get exposure to a wide range of clients and industries
  • Real professional growth from day one
  • Help shape technical solutions that directly impact client success


Important Note: To be considered, please attach your university transcript when applying.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Software Engineer (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI)
description:
Role: Software Engineer – Investments (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI))

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: CST

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote (Candidates Can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Investments Technology team , helping design and build secure, scalable healthcare and identity management platforms . You’ll work across the stack using C#, .NET 8+, Azure , and Angular , while leveraging GitHub Copilot and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that power secure healthcare and financial applications in a collaborative, remote-first environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and Build Scalable Solutions: Develop secure, high-performance applications using C#, .NET 8+, Entity Framework , and SQL .
  • Architect Modern Systems: Implement REST APIs, event-driven microservices , and integrations using Azure Service Bus and API Management (APIM) .
  • Leverage Azure Cloud: Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Service , integrate messaging, and expose APIs securely.
  • Implement Secure Authentication: Enhance identity management solutions using OAuth2 and OpenID Connect for secure access control.
  • Develop Front-End Interfaces: Build responsive UIs with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML to deliver excellent user experiences.
  • Optimize Data & APIs: Write efficient SQL queries, design APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger , and use Copilot to automate documentation.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Product, DevOps, and QA to deliver seamless, high-quality releases within CI/CD pipelines .
  • Innovate with GenAI: Use GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering to generate code, API specs, and test scripts, boosting productivity and speed.


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building production-grade applications with C# and .NET Core/8+ .
  • Strong understanding of REST , event-driven , and microservice architectures.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Service Bus, and APIM .
  • Proficiency in SQL and Entity Framework for database interactions.
  • Front-end experience with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML .
  • Expertise with OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar GenAI tools.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in remote, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) or other IAM platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (HIPAA) and secure data handling.
  • Exposure to Azure Event Hubs , Kafka , or AutoGen frameworks.

title: Salesforce Developer OmniStudio
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner , we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Join Our Team:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in OmniStudio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing OmniStudio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!


Job Description:

  • Develop solutions using Omni Studio tools such as OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards to build dynamic, customer-centric applications.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical designs.
  • Create technical specifications and designs for Omni Studio components that align with project objectives and Salesforce best practices.
  • Customize and configure the Salesforce platform using declarative tools to meet business needs, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce technologies as needed.
  • Implement integrations with third-party systems using Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to ensure the quality and functionality of the solutions.
  • Manage the deployment process using tools like Salesforce DX, change sets, or version control systems, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments.
  • Create detailed documentation for developed solutions, including design documents, user guides, and maintenance instructions.
  • Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions, addressing any issues that arise in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of Omni Studio solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently within Salesforce governor limits.
  • Work closely with project managers, other developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand their evolving needs, and make recommendations for enhancements or new features.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with the team, contributing to the collective expertise and professional development of colleagues.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Salesforce releases, Omni Studio updates, and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
  • Ensure that all development work complies with company policies, industry standards, and Salesforce security guidelines.


Requirements:

  • Integration Procedure
  • Data Raptor
  • Omniscript
  • FlexCard
  • Calculation Matrices
  • Validation Rule
  • Flow
  • Profile
  • Lightning Page
  • Role
  • Apex
  • LWC


Skill Set:

  • Omni Studio Proficiency: Strong experience with Omni Studio tools, including OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards.
  • Salesforce Development: Proficiency in Apex programming, Visualforce pages, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Declarative Tools: Expertise in using Salesforce's declarative tools for customization.
  • Integration Skills: Experience with Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Testing: Ability to write comprehensive test cases and perform various testing methods.
  • Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • Deployment: Experience with deployment methodologies and tools like Salesforce DX.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Agile Methodology: Understanding of Agile development practices.
  • Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying current with Salesforce features and updates.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Salesforce Developer OmniStudio
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner , we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Join Our Team:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in OmniStudio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing OmniStudio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!


Job Description:

  • Develop solutions using Omni Studio tools such as OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards to build dynamic, customer-centric applications.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical designs.
  • Create technical specifications and designs for Omni Studio components that align with project objectives and Salesforce best practices.
  • Customize and configure the Salesforce platform using declarative tools to meet business needs, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce technologies as needed.
  • Implement integrations with third-party systems using Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to ensure the quality and functionality of the solutions.
  • Manage the deployment process using tools like Salesforce DX, change sets, or version control systems, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments.
  • Create detailed documentation for developed solutions, including design documents, user guides, and maintenance instructions.
  • Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions, addressing any issues that arise in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of Omni Studio solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently within Salesforce governor limits.
  • Work closely with project managers, other developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand their evolving needs, and make recommendations for enhancements or new features.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with the team, contributing to the collective expertise and professional development of colleagues.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Salesforce releases, Omni Studio updates, and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
  • Ensure that all development work complies with company policies, industry standards, and Salesforce security guidelines.


Requirements:

  • Integration Procedure
  • Data Raptor
  • Omniscript
  • FlexCard
  • Calculation Matrices
  • Validation Rule
  • Flow
  • Profile
  • Lightning Page
  • Role
  • Apex
  • LWC


Skill Set:

  • Omni Studio Proficiency: Strong experience with Omni Studio tools, including OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards.
  • Salesforce Development: Proficiency in Apex programming, Visualforce pages, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Declarative Tools: Expertise in using Salesforce's declarative tools for customization.
  • Integration Skills: Experience with Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Testing: Ability to write comprehensive test cases and perform various testing methods.
  • Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • Deployment: Experience with deployment methodologies and tools like Salesforce DX.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Agile Methodology: Understanding of Agile development practices.
  • Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying current with Salesforce features and updates.

title: Junior Murex Operations
description:
Project Description:

DXC-Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities:

  • 2-5 years of experience in financial markets/IT business analysis
  • Financial products knowledge preferred
  • Murex functional and technical knowledge is preferred
  • Knowledge of Business workflows Contract, confirmation, settlements, collateral.
  • MxML
  • Data dictionary languages, SQL, XSL
  • Swift
  • Knowledge of Collateral, Markitwire and Margin Manager is a plus


  • Mandatory Skills Description:
  • 2+ years of Murex Operations and MxML/WF experience
  • Financial products knowledge preferred
  • Murex functional and technical knowledge is preferred
  • Knowledge of Business workflows Contract, confirmation, settlements, collateral.
  • MxML
  • Data dictionary languages, SQL, XSL
  • Swift
  • Knowledge of Collateral, Markitwire and Margin Manager is a plus
  • Strong hands on knowledge of OPS processing, MarkitWire, and Trade Life Cycle management
  • Strong understanding of OSP (open settlement protocol - Open Settlement Protocol (OSP) is a client-server protocol that manages access control, accounting, usage data and inter-domain routing to make it easier for Internet service providers (ISPs) to support IP telephony), Workflows, Operations, Fixings process, Confirmations, and Trade Life Cycle
  • Strong understanding of Back Office functions as well as processing
  • Strong functional and technical understanding on the settlement instructions
  • Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers
  • Good understanding and hands-on experience in Batch processing, Cash Flow Management, and End of Day issue resolutions flow(s)
  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills
  • Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally
  • Strong experience in supporting end-users and resolving their daily issues


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Engineer Manager
description:
Remoto | Grupo SBF | Ecossistema do Esporte


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engineering Manager para liderar nossas equipes de engenharia com foco em excelência técnica, impacto nos negócios e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Essa é uma posição estratégica de liderança, com responsabilidade direta sobre entregas, pessoas e processos.

Se você tem paixão por formar times de alta performance, toma decisões baseadas em dados e sabe equilibrar visão técnica e foco em pessoas, essa vaga pode ser sua próxima jornada!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança à frente de mais de um contexto;
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Histórico de entregas com impacto real (eficiência, performance, redução de custo ou aumento de satisfação);
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e metodologias ágeis ;
  • Familiaridade com métricas de times de engenharia (DORA Metrics ou similares);
  • Experiência com sistemas críticos e em escala ;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e empática ;
  • Capacidade de liderar e desenvolver times diversos , promovendo um ambiente seguro , colaborativo e de crescimento ;
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em resolver problemas complexos com inovação e senso de urgência.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar times de engenharia, garantindo entregas estratégicas com qualidade e alinhamento aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Atuar próximo a Produto, Design, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir sinergia e integração nas entregas;
  • Ser responsável por desenvolvimento de pessoas, feedbacks, mentoring e formação de cultura;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas relevantes, com foco em escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance;
  • Gerenciar orçamento, riscos e priorizações, com capacidade de adaptação e liderança em momentos de crise;
  • Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de experimentação e aprendizagem contínua.


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior em e-commerce ou ambientes de larga escala;
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação organizacional ou melhoria contínua;
  • Publicações técnicas, participação em comunidades, eventos ou contribuições open source;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança (OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001) e atuação com Security Champions.


—

Se interessou?

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções de software de alta qualidade, seguindo boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participar do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a análise de requisitos até a implantação;
  • Criar e manter APIs, aplicativos web e sistemas backend e frontend utilizando linguagens de programação como Java e Typescript;
  • Integrar soluções de software com sistemas legados e APIs de terceiros;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho e bugs nos sistemas;
  • Participar de revisões de código, testes e implantações;
  • Contribuir com a melhoria contínua dos processos e ferramentas de desenvolvimento;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos efetuados.


Requisitos:

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Pleno
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Local de trabalho: Remoto


Modelo de trabalho: CLT


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Resolver problemas e contribuir com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhece-las, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação
  • Experiência com APIs
  • Raciocínio logico


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis e focadas na cliente.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc
  • Entende como CI/CD funciona.
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo.
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento mobile


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:


  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD
